Strategy: Prefer near-tileable leftovers. A leftover just above a whole number of same-size items is perfectly tileable, while one just below wastes almost a whole item. Score bins by leftover with a bonus when the leftover sits in the lower half of an item-sized band, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a bin in an even half-band. Exact fits rank top. It may help by keeping leftovers tileable, but may fail because later items rarely repeat this size.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item if ((r - item) // (item / 2)) % 2 == 0 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Near-tiling bonus: +item when leftover is in the lower half of an item-sized band.
